name: Data root onboarding should walk you through steps
description: Problem: Data Root onboarding (src/tui/screens/onboarding/RootOnboarding.tsx) keeps its step only in memory and has no step indicator. Its factory step pushes the Factory setup and Stage Prompt editing routes, which the Shell draws as Modals over onboarding, so after esc the person is back on the same factory menu with no sign the action ran (see the attached screenshot). Goal: make Data Root onboarding a step-by-step flow on the main screen, with progress saved in the Data Root configuration. Requirements: (1) No Modals: every onboarding action happens inside the onboarding screen; Factory setup runs inline in its step and shows what it added and kept there; inline Stage Prompt editing within onboarding is ROW-78, so the Stage Prompts step hosts what ROW-78 builds instead of building it again. (2) Step tabs at the top: Mode, Board, Plugins, AI and skills, Factory setup, Stage Prompts, Finish; the two factory steps appear only when Software Factory is on (Software Factory or Both), Plugins is left out for the Software Factory mode as today, and clicking a tab opens its step. (3) On-screen Back, Next and Skip onboarding Buttons with key caps that follow the rowbly-tui-design skill; Skip keeps ctrl+k and saves onboardingComplete as today; Back and Next must not use ctrl+b or ctrl+n (already bound) or take keys from text fields and lists; Next never requires a step to be complete, and Next on the last step finishes onboarding. (4) Completion marks: a tab shows a mark once its step is done (Mode chosen, Board chosen or created, Plugin choices saved, AI question answered or a skill installed, factory setup ran successfully, Stage Prompts step left with Next), and after an action the step stays on screen with its result instead of returning to a menu. (5) Progress in config, as the original Story asks: completed steps are saved in the committed rowbly.config.json beside onboardingComplete as an optional field (for example onboardingSteps, a list of step ids; unknown ids are ignored), shared like that flag; reopening onboarding (Settings, Onboarding, or switching to an incomplete Data Root) shows the saved marks and opens the first incomplete step; absent means no steps are complete, and saving progress never clears onboardingComplete. Decisions and docs: add a new ADR in docs/agents/adr/ amending ADR-0041 section 2 (no new persistent settings) to allow saved step progress, update the Status line of ADR-0041 and add a row to docs/agents/adr/README.md; update docs/architecture/data-model.md for the new field, docs/architecture/operations.md if the input of config.updateRootConfig changes (today it patches only onboardingComplete), the Onboarding section of docs/user-guide.md, and the skills/rowbly reference if it describes onboarding. Out of scope: global onboarding, Settings, and the Stage Prompts screen outside onboarding. Tests: none required by AGENTS.md; verify in the TUI with agentic-tui screenshots in the PR. Related: ROW-78 (inline Stage Prompt editing within onboarding, Settings unchanged).

comments.author: sunny
comments.body: Refinement: the cause is that Factory setup and Stage Prompt editing are pushed routes drawn as Modals, and onboarding keeps its step only in memory. The description now lists requirements for step tabs, Back, Next and Skip Buttons, inline steps, completion marks, and step progress saved in rowbly.config.json, which needs a new ADR amending ADR-0041 section 2 (the Story asks for this). Inline Stage Prompt editing within onboarding belongs to ROW-78; this Story hosts it in its Stage Prompts step. Ready for development.

comments.body: Draft PR: https://github.com/sgolovine/rowbly/pull/171 (head 47495cf92bcd7730d511e3034b142a81bc2fe8da, branch factory/row-77-implementation). Data Root onboarding is step tabs (Mode, Board, Plugins, AI and skills, Factory setup, Stage Prompts, Finish) with Back ctrl+left, Next ctrl+right and Skip onboarding ctrl+k Buttons. Every step runs inline and keeps its result. Finished steps are saved as onboardingSteps in rowbly.config.json, and reopening opens the first step not done. ADR-0057 amends ADR-0041 section 2. The step reuses OnboardingPluginStep (ROW-78) and the Factory setup auto-run (ROW-75). The Factory setup mark is saved on leaving the step, so a rowbly.config.json Plugin reload does not run setup twice. Validation: typecheck, lint, test:unit (79) and test:cli (21) pass. Manual agentic-tui run with 11 screenshots in the PR. No review findings to answer yet.
